title: Choose the composition
question: Continuity Card is locked. Which layout should AirScreen wait in?

options.label: Centered plate
options.thesis: One glass card in the field: name, status, and four text controls live inside it.
options.viewport: Dark field. Centered plate. Huge AirScreen. Waiting for iPhone. Controls in the plate.
options.risk: Controls compete with the name at the same object.

options.label: Display slab
options.thesis: The plate is a stage for the name; controls sit underneath as a separate row.
options.viewport: Shorter 16:9 glass slab. Name owns the plate. Rename / Full Screen / Always on Top / Require PIN below it.
options.risk: Reads as a TV with a caption bar if the plate gets too wide.

options.label: Full-bleed glass
options.thesis: The window is the plate: name at optical center, capsules pinned to the bottom.
options.viewport: Thin dark margin. Near-full glass. Giant AirScreen. Status. Four capsules at the plate floor.
options.risk: Loses the Continuity-card silhouette if the margin is too thin.
